selected_business_requirements.authority: Course Owner is final strategic/system authority; General Manager owns routine administration and operations; Academic Manager owns academic operations/progress; Finance Manager owns finance/payroll; Reception owns intake/reception.
selected_business_requirements.access_and_audit: Role-based staff access, auditable important activity, and offboarding access revocation with historical-record preservation are required.
selected_business_requirements.branch_isolation: Multi-branch architecture and branch-level operational isolation are required; native Company/Branch remains an authority where applicable and is not assumed to be tenant isolation by itself.
selected_business_requirements.current_deployment: Local/server-based database and files, accessed by authorized staff through Tailscale.
selected_business_requirements.future_deployment: Internet-hosted deployment is a future phase; provider, hostname, DNS, public edge, and public TLS values are not selected.
selected_business_requirements.backup_recovery: Automated multi-version encrypted backup and recovery onto another system are required; data preservation has priority over minimizing recovery time; future off-site support is desired.
selected_business_requirements.configurable_policy: Fees, discounts, courses, levels, skills, terms, and fixed/skill-based teacher compensation remain configurable and use native authorities where applicable.
selected_business_requirements.control_center: Course Owner requires controlled role/permission administration and a high-level health/attention dashboard; General Manager receives role-appropriate operational visibility.
selected_business_requirements.deferred_scope: Student/guardian portal and online payment gateway are not launch scope.

notes: Owner business requirements are selected in the canonical record and are not production evidence. Numeric capacity/availability targets, future provider/hostname/DNS/public-edge values, future off-site destination, and numeric RPO/RTO are not supplied. Production must remain disabled and REJECT; current D8 gates remain BLOCKED until independently proven.
